messages:
sam: T-minus 25 to canary traffic shift. Quick checklist before we start drain + warmup?
alex: Copy. I'm on infra checks: draining 2 standby pools, warming caches, verifying autoscaler.
jana: Release notes link: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-21 - noted API changes to /v1/generate; remind folks to pin older model variant as fallback.
chris: TL;DR on rollback thresholds? CPU > 85% or 5xx rate > 1% for 3m = rollback. I can own rollback if hit.
marta: Please ensure canary pin is set for the old model variant (v3.2-q) as immediate fallback. I pushed the pin request.
deploy-bot: @sam executing step: PREPARE_CANARY (drain=2, warmup=enabled). Logs: deploy/3076543210/prep started.
alex: Health check snippet (run on canary nodes):
```
curl -sS http://canary-host/health | jq .
# expect {"status":"ok","latency_ms":<100}
```
jana: Also: quiet period starts at shift -5m; all non-critical deploys freeze now. @all please ack.
sam: acked. Ops will hold non-urgent merges.
opsbot: Quiet window enabled by policy: changewindow/launch-2026-03-21 enabled. Non-critical CI jobs paused.
deploy-bot: CANARY_SHIFT 10% -> applied. Observing for 3 minutes. Metrics: latency +2ms, error 0.02%.
chris: watching logs; seeing a small GC spike on one pod, but below threshold.
marta: warm cache confirmation: prefix hits 87% on canary. good.
jana: remind: toggle for autoscaler emergency-limit is set to 2x baseline. Keep eyes on pod spinup time.
sam: if error rate crosses 0.5% or sustained latency +40ms for 3m, we execute immediate rollback. Chris please ready.
chris: copy. Rollback playbook pinned here: https://internal.playbooks/rollback-v2 (I have steps 1-4 open).
deploy-bot: CANARY_SHIFT 30% -> applied. Observing. Metrics: error 0.03%, latency +6ms.
alex: Can we confirm DB read replicas are within rps targets? I'm seeing one replica 10% high but within window.
sam: Hold at 30% for 7m, then evaluate for full rollout. Everyone please post quick signoffs or concerns in next 5m.
jana: signoff from product: OK. Release note update pushed to PR.
marta: infra signoff: OK, draining completed, warmup good.
chris: ops signoff: OK. Ready for escalation if needed.
sam: thanks. I'll update the launch doc and start final rollout checklist after 7m. :thumbsup:
